A member of [[One Sith]] after the death of [[Darth Krayt]], a '''Snivvian Sith''' infiltrated the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government of [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]]. By [[138 ABY]], Cadomai Prime needed a new reliable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] due to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] devastation of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], which in turn drew a sizable criminal element to the collapsed area. A committee of three [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] politicians subsequently entered negotiations with a team of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] representatives to this end; one of the Snivvian envoys was the secret Sith operative. After an unsuccessful conference with the Gran, the Snivvian Sith was attacked by the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wredd]], who was hunting down other Sith. After a short but fierce [[Duel on Cadomai Prime|duel]], Wredd emerged victorious, impaling the Snivvian with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and casting his foe's body at the feet of his fellow politicians. When they saw that Wredd had scraped the Snivvian's [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and revealed the red-and-black [[Sith tattoo]]s on his face, the politicians realized he had been a traitor among them.<ref name="Legacy 6" />
